title: Trip Itinerary
description: 8-segment day-by-day itinerary for Vasilis & Athina's Aug 3–20, 2026 Tanzania trip — every stay with dates, lodging name, city/country, night count, and cost from the spreadsheet. Chronological order.

city.description: City or area name (Cairo, Arusha, Tarangire, Ngorongoro, Stone Town, Kiwengwa, Dar es Salaam)

nights.description: Number of nights in this segment

meal_plan.description: Meal plan if applicable (FB, HB, or empty for self-catered/hotel default)

cost_usd.description: Lodging cost in USD from the spreadsheet (or total package cost for safari)

notes.description: Extra context: flight connections, activities, tips from trip journal
